Exercise: Glute Ham Raise

Category:
powerlifting

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- eccentric_concentric

Primary Muscles:

- hamstrings

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes

Equipment:

- machine

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- posterior_chain_strength
- hamstring_hypertrophy
- glute_activation

Contraindications:

- Lower back issues
- Recent knee surgery

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single Leg Glute Ham Raise, force: pull, level: intermediate
- name: Glute Ham Raise with Resistance Bands, force: pull, level: intermediate

Substitution Options:

- name: Romanian Deadlift, force: pull, level: intermediate
- name: Deadlift, force: pull, level: advanced

Instructions:

- Begin by adjusting the equipment to fit your body. Place your feet against the footplate in between the rollers as you lie facedown. Your knees should be just behind the pad.
- Start from the bottom of the movement. Keep your back arched as you begin the movement by flexing the knees. Drive your toes into the foot plate as you do so. Keep your upper body straight, and continue until your body is upright.
- Return to the starting position, keeping your descent under control.
